en: Antique postcard with a chromolithograph of a young woman in a yellow dress reclining and smoking inside a heart-shaped vignette, with drawings of books and banknotes below and handwritten Swedish text across the image. The reverse shows address lines with the heading 'BREFKORT. Postkarte.' and a green Swedish 5 öre stamp canceled with a circular postmark, addressed to Norberg.
